overview: The council approved legal settlements for personal injury claims and addressed procedural conflicts arising from a concurrent Zoning Board of Appeals meeting. A resolution to reschedule an upcoming council meeting was tabled due to a scheduling conflict with a utility hearing.

items.title: Claim for Medical Expenses
items.summary: Approved a claim for medical expenses totaling $6,500 following a brief discussion regarding the categorization of out-of-pocket costs.

items.title: Settlement for Deidre Alessio v. City of Medford
items.summary: Approved a $5,000 expenditure, the statutory cap, for a claim involving a fractured elbow and concussion caused by a pothole on College Avenue.

items.title: Recess Request for ZBA Hearing
items.summary: Councilor Lungo-Koehn requested a 20-minute recess for members to testify at a Zoning Board of Appeals meeting regarding a development at Medford Street and Broadway; however, Councilor Knight urged the body to finish the remaining agenda items first.

items.title: Resolution 17-726: Meeting Start Time
items.summary: Tabled a resolution to move the October 31st meeting start time to 8:00 p.m. because a National Grid hearing was already noticed for 7:00 p.m.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Adjournment
items.summary: Tabled the records of the October 17th meeting and adjourned the session.
